Out of focus: Setup › Apps is outside #34571's scope. The effect is real: the admin is left with no default app until they set one again. Alone that would be p2, so one grade lower out of focus gives p3. Kept open, not closed.

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in area:build · domain:ui · Bug · p1 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: in Setup › Apps, "Set as default" on an app in a read-only package first clears the current default, then its own write is refused, and nothing rolls back. The deployment is left with no default app (reproduced twice). The refusal is shown, but the lost default is not: a silent lost update, so p3 → p1. Graded, not chased (area:build has no seat). Audit restatement, tier 3. Recorded 2026-11-27T13:21Z.

Surface amended (claim 7220058148), before the first push, from os-dev-report 7221993316:
- Added: `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (11 files) — one new key `appManagement.toast.restoreDefaultFailed` (the second toast that names an app whose restore was refused); `@object-ui/i18n` patch beside `@object-ui/console` in `.changeset/34860-app-set-default-restore.md`.
- Added: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/__tests__/AppManagementPage.honestWrites-12300.test.tsx`, one existing case that pinned the defect ("a demotion that landed is shown, not hidden": after a refused promote, no app is the default). It now asserts the fix's outcome: 3 writes (demote → refused promote → restore), the previous default `lanebapp_app` still shows "Default" after the re-read, and `showcase_app` does not. Not loosened: it still requires the error toast, no success toast and the re-read after failure, and it now pins the restore write and which app holds the default.
- Not done: the card's other branch, "refuse a locked target before any write". The page reads no package writability, so that branch needs a new read (a new server call or contract), which the claim excludes. The restore satisfies the card's Expected ("a refused set-default leaves `/meta/app` unchanged") for the 403 case. Acceptance note in the PR body: a promote that errors after the server applied it (e.g. a timeout) would be followed by a restore and leave two defaults; the page cannot tell that apart from a refusal without a new read.
- Still out: server code, root `packages/**`, `docs/adr/**`. Clause-② no, Metadata-protocol none.
